시편 102:1.content: A Prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed, and poureth out his complaint before the Lord. Hear my prayer, O Lord, and let my cry come unto thee.

시편 102:2.content: Hide not thy face from me in the day when I am in trouble; incline thine ear unto me: in the day when I call answer me speedily.

시편 102:3.content: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as an hearth.

시편 102:4.content: My heart is smitten, and withered like grass; so that I forget to eat my bread.

시편 102:5.content: By reason of the voice of my groaning my bones cleave to my skin.

시편 102:6.content: I am like a pelican of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the desert.

시편 102:7.content: I watch, and am as a sparrow alone upon the house top.

시편 102:8.content: Mine enemies reproach me all the day; and they that are mad against me are sworn against me.

시편 102:9.content: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping,

시편 102:10.content: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: for thou hast lifted me up, and cast me down.

시편 102:11.content: My days are like a shadow that declineth; and I am withered like grass.

시편 102:12.content: But thou, O Lord, shalt endure for ever; and thy remembrance unto all generations.

시편 102:13.content: Thou shalt arise, and have mercy upon Zion: for the time to favour her, yea, the set time, is come.

시편 102:14.content: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, and favour the dust thereof.

시편 102:15.content: So the heathen shall fear the name of the Lord, and all the kings of the earth thy glory.

시편 102:16.content: When the Lord shall build up Zion, he shall appear in his glory.

시편 102:17.content: He will regard the prayer of the destitute, and not despise their prayer.

시편 102:18.content: This shall be written for the generation to come: and the people which shall be created shall praise the Lord.

시편 102:19.content: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; from heaven did the Lord behold the earth;

시편 102:20.content: To hear the groaning of the prisoner; to loose those that are appointed to death;

시편 102:21.content: To declare the name of the Lord in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;

시편 102:22.content: When the people are gathered together, and the kingdoms, to serve the Lord.

시편 102:23.content: He weakened my strength in the way; he shortened my days.

시편 102:24.content: I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: thy years are throughout all generations.

시편 102:25.content: Of old hast thou laid the foundation of the earth: and the heavens are the work of thy hands.

시편 102:26.content: They shall perish, but thou shalt endure: yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; as a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed:

시편 102:27.content: But thou art the same, and thy years shall have no end.

시편 102:28.content: The children of thy servants shall continue, and their seed shall be established before thee.
